units.source_text: 是的，正是我发现那具尸体的。

en.t: Yes, I was the one who found that corpse.

units.source_text: 今儿一早，我和平时一样去后山砍杉树。

en.t: Early this morning, I went to the back mountain as usual to cut cedar trees.

units.source_text: 没想到山后面的竹林里，竟然有这么一具尸体。

en.t: To my surprise, there was a corpse like this in the bamboo grove behind the mountain.

units.source_text: 距离山科的驿路约莫四五町远。

en.t: It is about four or five cho from the Yamashina road.

units.source_text: 竹林中零落生长着一些矮小的杉树，那是一个荒无人烟的地方。

en.t: A few short cedar trees grew scattered through the bamboo grove, and it was a deserted, uninhabited place.
